newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1995/96 soybean crop 98 pct sold - Safras.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1995/96 soybean crop 98 pct sold - Safras.

text.p: Around 98 percent of Brazil's 1995/96 soybean crop was sold by November 21, leaving only 387,000 tonnes still to be negotiated, said independent consultants Safras e Mercado in its weekly newsletter.
Of the remaining crop to be sold, 180,000 tonnes are in Rio Grande do Sul and 150,000 tonnes in Parana, it added.
In the last fortnight, there has been a pick-up in buying interest in the old crop and this should be the last buying spurt of the year, Safras said.

Prices have subsequently picked up and in some areas are the highest so far this year. November prices are generally 24 to 30 percent above those seen in November last year and 39 to 51 percent above the average in the last 10 years, Safras said.
In Parana and Rio Grande do Sul, prices are around 17.50 and 18 reais per 60-kg bag respectively against 14.13 and 14.16 reais at the same stage last year, Safras said.
